# Security

This beta processes untrusted media through external parsers and local models.
Use an isolated environment for unfamiliar media. The Web UI is designed for
loopback use and is not a hosted multi-user service.

For a vulnerability, use the repository's private vulnerability reporting feature
if enabled. Do not publish working credentials, personal data, or an exploit
against a live third-party service in a public issue. If private reporting is
unavailable, open a minimal issue requesting a private contact without disclosing
the sensitive details. No response-time guarantee is currently offered.
